hints.title: Short Answer Bound
hints.text: Because string length is bounded and repeated k times, maximum answer length cannot exceed seven.

hints.title: Frequency Pruning
hints.text: Only characters with frequency at least k can ever appear in the target subsequence. Sort them in descending alphabetical order.

hints.title: Breadth-First Generation
hints.text: Perform breadth-first search from empty string, extending valid candidates by adding each candidate character and verifying subsequence validity.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(|s| * sum(|valid|^L)) where L is at most 7
complexity.space: O(queue width) to store candidate strings
complexity.notes: Subsequence verification takes linear scan over s.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all subsequences of s directly is exponentially intractable.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Building candidates from short to long with BFS prunes branches as soon as they fail subsequence check.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should realize answer length <= 7 and prune search tree via BFS.
